A year ago, I made a video asking “Why is India so mediocre?”
Sadly, instead of improving, things feel even worse today.

From collapsing infrastructure and fake awards to polluted air, contaminated water, paper leaks, and open corruption—this video is a brutal recap of everything that went wrong. But this isn’t just about politicians or babus. It’s about us.

Flower pots stolen after PM events. Garbage thrown from luxury cars. Racism against North Eastern Indians. Mob violence in the name of religion. Zero civic sense, zero empathy, and full entitlement. We worship rivers, women, guests—but treat all three with shocking disrespect in real life.

This video connects the dots between bad governance and bad societal mindset. Because the truth is simple:
The system is broken because we are broken.

No fake optimism. No propaganda. Just a mirror.
Watch till the end before judging.
